title: Rosemary Beach "Savannah Loft" 5 Main Street Unit 1C
h1: Rosemary Beach "Savannah Loft" 5 Main Street Unit 1C
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf views- 1-minute walk to the white sand beach- Walking distance to all four Rosemary Beach community pools- Three Balconies: one large with Gulf view and tables/seating for six, one private off primary bedroom suite, another private off guest bedroom- 1 dedicated parking spot with additional parking available throughout community- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Rosemary Beach is a destination like no other, and "Savannah Loft" is a beautiful gem at the heart of it. A spacious 1670 sq. ft., 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom condo featuring Gulf views, fireplace, walnut floors - and a lovely but brief walk to the beach. Savor your morning coffee on one of the balconies as you make plans for an amazing day. Of course, all the dining, shopping and entertainment opportunities are right outside your door, mere feet away on cobblestone streets and winding paths.Near-floor-to-ceiling windows provide plenty of natural light. The modern kitchen offers select stainless appliances, including a Viking gas range, designer cabinets, and white quartz countertops. It opens into the dining area, with table seating for 6 and seating for 3 at the counter. The living room offers a gas fireplace, a large flat-screen television, and French door balcony access - the perfect place to gather in the evening with family and friends. The sizeable 22'X14' primary bedroom features a king bed, flat-screen television, an extended 6'X9' sitting room with gorgeous views, and a private bathroom with dual sink vanities, seated makeup vanity, and shower. On the opposite corner of the floor-plan is the guest bedroom with a queen bed, flat-screen television, and a private bathroom with a single vanity and shower. The living room has a convenient half-bath close by.After a day in the sun on this idyllic 30a beach, experience poolside at one of the extraordinary Rosemary Beach pools. Gather with friends and family on the balcony to take in sunset over the Gulf. In the evening, explore the incredible communities of 30A, including Alys Beach, Seaside, WaterColor, and Grayton Beach -- all just a short drive away. "Savannah Loft" makes the perfect 30A getaway -- the best the Emerald Coast can offer. This Rosemary Beach condo sleeps 4.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Cribs available upon request MAIN ACCESS to this second floor condo is through private lobby via elevator or stairwell. Additional access to condo via private stairwell on the backside exterior."Savannah Loft" offers access to these fantastic Rosemary Beach amenities:- Coquina Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm.; heated in the winter- Sky Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 6 am to 10 pm (Adult Only Hours, 6 am-9 am& 8 pm-10 pm)- Cabana Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm.- Barbados Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm.Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
